title: 12 Best Craft Beer in Pittsburgh
description: Discover the 12 best craft breweries and taprooms in Pittsburgh for 2026. From hazy IPAs to unique barrel-aged stouts, find your perfect pint in Steel City.

places.name: Brew Gentlemen
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order General Braddock's IPA (Hazy IPA) or White Sky (Wheat Beer) if available.

places.name: Dancing Gnome Brewery
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Underscore (IPA) or any of their rotating single hop IPAs.

places.name: Grist House Craft Brewery
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their 'Hazeway' series IPAs or the popular Camp Slop (S'mores Stout) if it's on tap.

places.name: Voodoo Brewery Homestead
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Big Black Voodoo Daddy (Imperial Stout) or their White Magick of the Sun (Witbier) paired with the Mac & Cheese.

places.name: The Church Brew Works
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Pious Monk Dunkel (Munich Dark Lager) or Celestial Gold (Golden Lager) with their famous Pierogi Pizza.

places.name: East End Brewing Co.
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Big Hop IPA (American IPA) and a fresh-made pepperoni roll or a slice of their pizza.

places.name: Allegheny City Brewing
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their hazy IPAs or their 'Allegheny City Lager' for a refreshing classic.

places.name: Cinderlands Beer Co.
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Tracks (Hazy IPA) or a rotating sour, paired with their Nashville Hot Chicken Sandwich.

places.name: Necromancer Brewing
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try their rotating historical style, like a Gose or Lichtenhainer, or a well-executed classic.

places.name: Trace Brewing
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A house lager or their latest IPA, and don't forget to grab a coffee if you're there earlier in the day.

places.name: Southern Tier Brewing Company Pittsburgh
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order 2XIPA (Double IPA) or their Pumking (Imperial Pumpkin Ale) in season, paired with the Bavarian Pretzel.

places.name: Roundabout Brewery
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any of their well-balanced lagers or their take on a classic IPA, often served in proper glassware.
